newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices bounce back, then fall.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices bounce back, then fall.

text.p: Indian castorseed September delivery prices on Wednesday bounced back but then fell at the close on sluggish overseas interest and rising supply, dealers said.
"Prices dropped to 1,145/1,146 rupees as sluggish overseas enquiries and continued supplies prompted fresh bull liquidation," a dealer said.
Prices earlier in the day fetched 1,149/1,150 rupees per quintal from 1,144/1,145 rupees on the back of light short covering, he said.
Daily average arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region remained high at 25,000/30,000 bags (75 kg each).

Groundnut oil continued steady at 360/362 rupees per 10 kg as limited arrivals of 40/50 tonnes matched with poor offtake. Imported palm oil on the other hand moved down by 2/3 rupees at 275/276 rupees per 10 kg on continued supplies at the Bombay port as well as weak trends in the world market.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil moved up by 2/3 rupees at 561/562 rupees per 15 kg due to lower crushing of summer crop amid frequent power cuts in the producing centres.
